subject.title: [Feature]: Add MLX Talk provider MVP for local macOS TTS

question: Should this issue stay open until `apps/macos-mlx-tts` uses a tagged `mlx-audio-swift` release with SwiftPM/macOS proof, or should maintainers accept the current raw revision and close the cleanup?
rationale: The main MLX provider behavior is shipped, but the issue explicitly asked for a tagged dependency and the follow-up PR for that change closed unmerged after dependency-resolution concerns.

options.title: Land tagged helper pin
options.body: Regenerate the helper SwiftPM lockfile against a tagged `mlx-audio-swift` release and verify helper resolve/build before closing this issue.

options.title: Accept current raw revision
options.body: Document that the raw helper revision is intentionally retained for compatibility or dependency-graph stability, then close this issue as product-complete.

options.title: Split follow-up tracker
options.body: Close this broad MVP issue only after opening a narrower maintainer-owned helper dependency tracker that preserves the remaining tagged-pin work.

recommendation.title: Land tagged helper pin
recommendation.body: Regenerate the helper SwiftPM lockfile against a tagged `mlx-audio-swift` release and verify helper resolve/build before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is centered on the isolated MLX helper package that Peter recently introduced and documented.
